item.title: Oquo RP50LTD wheels
item.description: Smooth, comfortable, responsive and fast – perhaps the best wheels I've ridden in 20 years 9/10

item.title: Universal Colours Women's Mono Cargo Bib Tight
item.description: Excellent tights suitable for all but the deepest winter days. 9/10

item.title: Cyclists told to “share the roads with other traffic” after safety scheme branded “missed opportunity” due to no bike lanes; Van der Poel trains for 3 hours… then dominates cyclocross race; Blythe white shorts shocker; TDU chaos + more on the live blog
item.description: The weekend may be over, but it’s not all bad: road racing’s on the TV, the football’s good again (you may disagree), and Ryan Mallon’s back with more cycling news, views, and silliness to distract you from the reality that is Monday

item.title: A wild concept bike, the next generation of fancy carbon wheels, Ridley's Noah goes electric, SRAM's 150mm cranks + more from Velofollies 2026
item.description: All the hottest new tech we spotted in Belgium, including stuff from SRAM, Van Rysel, Silca, Eddy Merckx, Deda, Ridley, Fizik, Prologo and more

item.title: Community service for new driver who killed cyclist while "driving too fast" on country road, a month after passing his test
item.description: A couple in their 70s were on a cycling holiday in Scotland when Aly Albosati lost control of his car and hit them both, Patricia Marshall airlifted to hospital where she died

item.title: road.cc Recommends Bikes of the Year 2025/26: the best gravel and adventure bikes
item.description: After countless miles of riding, we’ve hand-picked the best gravel machines that we’ve reviewed over the past 12 months. From featherweight flyers to long-haul adventurers, these are the bikes that proved their worth where it really counts

item.title: Police force insists cyclists' camera footage is taken seriously, after backlash to "no crime had been committed" response to near collision
item.description: West Yorkshire Police chose not to take action against taxi driver who cyclist alleged was "too busy checking their phone" when they turned into the rider's path

item.title: Business owner bills Lime £7,600 over parking row, after seizing e-bikes left on his property and taking operator to court
item.description: Boss of London building firm charges Lime £10 removal fee and £10 daily storage charge for every bike left on his company's property

item.title: A ban on drop bars by the organisers of America's most famous mountain bike race won't actually solve any problems
item.description: Famously won on a drop barred MTB last year, Life Time has announced its ban on curly bars in its Leadville and Big Sugar races but is this a positive step?

item.title: "It's not possible to say if work will be completed": UK council admits famous climb's Tour de France inclusion could be threatened by landslip repairs
item.description: Concerns landslip repairs could blight major climb ahead of Tour de France returning to the UK in 2027, with the county's council admitting it is impossible to say if works will be finished in time
